title: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1 - Ethics & Professional Responsibilities - Advertising and Marketing
exam: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1
subject: Ethics & Professional Responsibilities

questions.q: A paralegal decides to update their website's marketing material. Which of the following statements on the website violates the Law Society's Rules on Marketing?
options: Experienced in handling complex Landlord and Tenant Board disputes.
The most aggressive and successful paralegal in Toronto; 100% guaranteed wins.
Services provided in both English and French.
questions.explain: Rule 8.03 requires that marketing must be demonstrably true, accurate, and verifiable. It prohibits advertising that is misleading, confusing, or deceptive. Claims such as "the most aggressive" (unverifiable superlative) and "100% guaranteed wins" (misleading, as litigation outcomes cannot be guaranteed) clearly violate the marketing rules.
